text:
Aisha (CSM): Morning team — kicking off Ceres Analytics onboarding. First sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. Goals: API connected to staging, embeddings validated on 10k docs, baseline latency < 350ms p95, user training scheduled. Need owners for integration, enablement, SSO, and renewal ops. Agenda: intro, success criteria, timeline, blockers. @Marco / @Priya please confirm stakeholders attending.
Liam - Solutions Eng: I'll own API integration + smoke tests. Can we get a sample dataset? :+1:
Marco (Ceres): confirmed — I'll be there. Can assign Priya for infra. Sending sample dataset (redacted) by EOD. Question about SSO — we use Okta.
Devon - Enablement: I'll run two training sessions week 2: Admin (30m) and End-users (45m). Need feature flags list and sandbox access.
Aisha (CSM): noted. Devon — here's sandbox invite and feature flag list: https://redwood.example/sandboxes/ceres
OnboardBot: Calendar invite created: Ceres Onboarding — Kickoff — 10:00am PT — 1h. https://calendar.example/event/abc123
Priya (Ceres CTO): We need performance SLOs. Can we confirm expected qps and token lengths? Our analytics queries are often long (avg 1200 tokens).
Liam - Solutions Eng: For 1200 token sequences we'll test with model: meta-llama-2-13b-instruct - can run a perf sweep. I'll post perf matrix by Thursday.
Zoe - Renewal Ops: tagging renewal risk — current contract Q4 renewal. Success criteria linked to adoption: 3 teams active + 2 dashboards live. Want regular health check cadence.
Aisha (CSM): good call Zoe. Proposed timeline: Week0: kickoff + sandbox; Week1: API integration + embeddings; Week2: training + perf tuning; Week3: rollout to pilot users; Week5: adoption review and renewal health check.
Marco (Ceres): Ok sounds reasonable. On SSO: Do you support SCIM user provisioning? We need auto-provisioning.
Liam - Solutions Eng: Yes, we support SCIM. Devon, can you include SCIM steps in enablement doc? Also adding quick curl example for API auth:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"meta-llama-2-13b-instruct","input":"test"}'
```
Devon - Enablement: Will add SCIM + curl snippet to deck. Also prepping quickstart lab for hands-on demo.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks — action items: Liam (API + perf matrix), Devon (training + SCIM doc), Marco/Priya (sample data + confirm attendees), Zoe (renewal health cadence). I'll send updated playbook after kickoff. :raised_hands: 
Marco (Ceres): Thanks all. One more ask — can we get a checklist for compliance (data residency, KMS)? I'll loop Legal.
Aisha (CSM): Yes, sending compliance checklist before EOD. Attaching docs: https://redwood.example/docs/onboard/ceres-checklist
OnboardBot: Reminder set: follow-up perf matrix due Thursday 9am PT.
